_about: Knees-up crops of the four freeze pose clips, for NOVA_FACE=ditto.
Ditto needs her face at 200-470 px, which forces a ~1.72x knees-up reframe of the
LIVE body. PoseClip overlays cover the whole stage (inset:0, object-fit:contain,
z6 over the live video at z3), so at a freeze the picture would jump from knees-up
to full-body unless the pose clips are reframed the same way. These are that reframe.
MEASURED 2026-10-30 (branch nova-ditto): 3 of the 4 poses do not survive it.

crop.fps: unchanged (24) — these are page overlays, not a Ditto source
crop.from: docs/ditto-try/reframe_plan.jsonl (the box that put her face at ~280 px)

star.pose_is: both arms out — the star's points are her HANDS
star.why: the landmarks that MAKE this pose are outside the crop — what is left does not read as the pose

frog.pose_is: deep squat — the shape is the bent KNEES and the hands between them
frog.why: the landmarks that MAKE this pose are outside the crop — what is left does not read as the pose

bear.pose_is: both paws raised beside the head — the shape is the CLAWS
bear.why: the landmarks that MAKE this pose are outside the crop — what is left does not read as the pose

flamingo.pose_is: one leg raised, knee bent, foot tucked — the shape is the RAISED LEG
flamingo.why: the raised knee, shin and shoe all stay in frame; only the toe tip (~68 px) and her far hand (~50 px) leave it — the flamingo still reads

decision: DO NOT SHIP this crop as the live freeze set. 1 of 4 poses survives. The four clips were generated full-body with the limbs filling the frame edge to edge (star hands measured at x=20 and x=1087 of a 1076-wide frame — already at the edge BEFORE any crop), so no zoom that satisfies Ditto's 200 px face can keep them.
alternative: Re-generate the four pose clips AT knees-up framing (fal Kling, same still, same
room, face ~280 px) with the poses COMPOSED for the tighter frame: star arms up at
45 degrees instead of straight out, bear claws beside the cheeks instead of above
the head, frog a shallower squat so the knees stay up, flamingo unchanged.
That is a generation job for Refael's CLI (it needs FAL_KEY) — see docs/NOVA-DITTO.md RUN-ME.
